status: research and reuse plan, not Lean completion
priority_rule: First satisfy the front-loaded four-textbook critical path, then select a dependency-ready theorem delta with the largest audited downstream reuse per realistic proof cost. Textbook order is a source order, not necessarily the optimal Lean dependency order.

stages.title: Fix statements, spaces and access contracts
stages.target: Pin measures, spaces, norms, constants, metrics, input access, randomness, output error and source editions before comparing or sharing routes.
stages.search: Samplinglib Registry; active Frontier Cells; source maps; frontloaded-shared-spine.json

stages.title: Euclidean, inner-product and matrix floor
stages.target: Coordinates, inner products, norms, symmetric/PSD matrices and quadratic-energy conventions used repeatedly in the first textbook window.

stages.title: Measures, integration, maps and kernels floor
stages.target: Probability normalization, pushforwards, products, marginal transfer, finite moments and deterministic-map versus kernel interfaces.

stages.title: Differentiation, gradients, chain rules and Taylor bounds
stages.target: Source-neutral normed-space derivative/gradient/chain-rule interfaces; manifold and stochastic adapters remain explicit.

stages.title: Convexity, strong convexity, subgradients and log-concavity adapters
stages.target: One Euclidean convex/subgradient/strong-convexity core; log-concavity, geodesic convexity, mixture convexity and displacement convexity are typed adapters or separate statements.

stages.title: Couplings and minimal Wasserstein metric core
stages.target: Shared coupling membership, marginal bookkeeping, p-moment costs, deterministic couplings and metric identities needed by OT Chapter 1 and Sampling §1.3 before route-local transport code is written.

stages.title: Convex conjugacy and duality pulled forward
stages.target: Extract only the Fenchel/conjugacy core needed by OT §§1.5-1.6 from Optimization Chapter 9 without pretending Chapter 9 is complete.
stages.search: Mathlib convex conjugacy; Optlib/CvxLean; Chewi Optimization Ch.9; OT Ch.1 exact hypotheses

stages.title: Markov semigroup and generator foundations
stages.target: Kernel/semigroup laws, generator domains, Dirichlet forms and integration-by-parts interfaces for Sampling Chapters 1-2; this must not block unrelated OT/Optimization work.

stages.title: Minimal first-order manifold adapter
stages.target: Tangent spaces, differential, Riemannian metric and gradient interfaces. Boumal Chapter 3 may be pulled forward to unblock Sampling §2.5, with exact source dependencies retained.
stages.search: Mathlib manifold APIs; TechnicalLemmas/Geometry/GeodesicConvexity.lean; ATLAS geometry memory

stages.title: Empirical measures and concentration floor
stages.target: Share empirical-measure bookkeeping, Lipschitz-observable and basic concentration interfaces between Sampling §2.4 and OT Chapter 2; keep chaining, isoperimetry and minimax lower bounds separate unless statements exactly match.
stages.search: Mathlib probability/concentration; FunctionalInequalities; compatible lean-stat-learning-theory leaves

stages.title: Transport existence, Brenier/duality wrappers and displacement
stages.target: Build source-facing OT theorems on the shared metric/convex floor. Sampling §1.3 consumes the canonical transport core rather than creating a second mini-library.
stages.search: TechnicalLemmas/Measure transport files; OT Chapter 1; Sampling §1.3; source-specific Brenier/Kantorovich hypotheses

stages.title: Gibbs variational principle, KL and functional-inequality energy
stages.target: Common entropy/KL/convex core supports Sampling Chapter 2, OT Chapter 4 and proximal/MFLD routes; invariant-law and semigroup claims remain separate.
stages.search: TechnicalLemmas/InformationTheory; FunctionalInequalities; existing Fisher/entropy APIs; primary proofs

stages.title: Energy-dissipation and geometry-to-flow interfaces
stages.target: Share scalar energy-dissipation/Gronwall patterns first; connect Euclidean, Riemannian and Wasserstein flows only through explicit adapters whose hypotheses are proved.
stages.search: Optimization Ch.2; Sampling §§1.4-1.5; existing weak FP/FisherTransport APIs; AGS metric gradient-flow contracts

stages.title: Statistical OT and metric-geometry branches
stages.target: OT Chapters 2-3 empirical/statistical leaves and 7-8 metric geometry branch. Statistical observation count n is never identified with sampling oracle cost.
stages.search: OT Chapter 2-3 assumptions; Mathlib probability; concentration sources; statistical rather than computational n

stages.title: Higher-smoothness sampling upper bounds
stages.target: Fix one potential class and oracle, prove local remainder/moment bounds and invariant target, then combine with an existing compatible contraction theorem.
stages.search: Nesterov high-order Taylor models; Mou et al.; Shen-Lee; pinned sampling contraction leaves

stages.title: Sampling oracle lower bounds
stages.target: Separate hard-instance and information-transcript lane. Additional convexity or statistical-testing ingredients are task-specific, not every upper-bound lemma.
stages.search: SampleWiki exact lower-bound papers; oracle transcript kernels; testing/data-processing APIs

stages.title: Compare matched upper and lower contracts
stages.target: Only compare identical potential classes, derivative access, error metrics, starts and cost conventions. A cross-domain lower bound requires an explicit reduction.
stages.search: Common contract schema; no theorem equivalence inferred from a shared label
